by
  intro K _ _ θ p _ hp
  refine ⟨NumberField.Ideal.primesOverSpanEquivMonicFactorsMod hp, fun Q hQ => ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · exact NumberField.Ideal.inertiaDeg_primesOverSpanEquivMonicFactorsMod_symm_apply hp hQ
  · exact NumberField.Ideal.ramificationIdx_primesOverSpanEquivMonicFactorsMod_symm_apply hp hQ
  · exact NumberField.Ideal.primesOverSpanEquivMonicFactorsMod_symm_apply_eq_span hp hQ
target_source: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K] (θ : NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime], ¬ p ∣ RingOfIntegers.exponent θ → ∃ e : ↑((Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}).primesOver (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) ≃ ↥(RingOfIntegers.monicFactorsMod θ p), ∀ (Q : Polynomial ℤ) (hQ : Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod p)) Q ∈ RingOfIntegers.monicFactorsMod θ p), (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}).inertiaDeg (e.symm ⟨Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod p)) Q, hQ⟩ : Ideal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) = (Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod p)) Q).natDegree ∧ (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}).ramificationIdx (e.symm ⟨Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod p)) Q, hQ⟩ : Ideal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) = multiplicity (Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod p)) Q) (Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod p)) (minpoly ℤ θ)) ∧ (e.symm ⟨Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod p)) Q, hQ⟩ : Ideal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) = Ideal.span {(p : NumberField.RingOfIntegers K), Polynomial.aeval θ Q}
